items.title: DANG!
items.synopsis: DANG! follows a brother and sister duo whose fun, messy lives in New York City are interrupted when their worst nightmare comes true: their high-achieving older sister shows up and wants to hang out with them.
items.brief: A brother and sister's messy New York lives are interrupted when their high-achieving older sister wants to hang out.

items.title: All Star Preschool Playlist (Season 1)
items.synopsis: Zazie Olivia Beetz ( zə-SEE BAYTS; German: [zaˈsiː ˈbeːts]; born June 1, 1991) is a German-American actress. She is known for her role as Van in the FX comedy-drama series Atlanta (2016–2022), for which she received a nomination for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Comedy Series.…
items.brief: A preschool music playlist series.

items.title: Fauda (Season 5)
items.synopsis: Fauda (Arabic for 'Chaos') depicts the two-sided story of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Doron, a commander of undercover Israeli unit operating inside Palestinian territories, and his team, are hunting down Hamas activist Abu-Ahmed. On the other side of the fence, the tragic life of Abu-Ahmed and his family, and the reasons for their escalating hatred towards Israel.
items.brief: Fauda (Arabic for 'Chaos') depicts the two-sided story of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

items.title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
items.synopsis: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.
items.brief: Stavros Halkias roasts the healthcare system and imagines being a dirtbag uncle.

items.title: Ultimate Kids Playlist (Season 1)
items.synopsis: Michael Austin Cera ( SERR-ə; Italian: [ˈtʃeːra]; born June 7, 1988) is a Canadian actor and musician. Over his career, he has received nominations for a British Academy Film Award, three Critics' Choice Movie Awards, four Screen Actors Guild Awards, and a Tony Award.…
items.brief: A children's music playlist series.

items.title: Earle Meets World
items.synopsis: Candid, chaotic and still getting started, influencer Alix Earle navigates breakups, best friends and a unique blended family in this reality series.
items.brief: Influencer Alix Earle navigates breakups, best friends and her blended family.

items.title: On Campus: Game of the Week
items.synopsis: Every week at a different school, go inside campus life with real college students from the lead-up to the aftermath of college football's biggest games.
items.brief: College students share their experiences around big football games at different schools each week.

items.title: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
items.synopsis: A critical threat. A clandestine escape. And a Turkish catering truck? With firsthand accounts, "Instadocs" digs into what happened aboard Air Force One.
items.brief: A documentary about a critical incident aboard Air Force One involving a clandestine escape.

items.title: Teenage Wasteland
items.synopsis: Inspired by an unconventional teacher, a group of teenagers in upstate New York in the early 1990s make a student film and uncover a vast conspiracy that is poisoning their community. Thirty years later, they revisit their film and confront the legacy of this transformative experience.
items.brief: In the early 1990s, teenagers uncover a conspiracy poisoning their community through a student film.

items.title: The Gentlemen (Season 2)
items.synopsis: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to an enormous weed empire — and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.
items.brief: When aristocratic Eddie inherits his family estate, he discovers it harbors an enormous weed empire.

items.title: Famous Last Words
items.synopsis: Famous Last Words , a groundbreaking documentary series spotlighting renowned cultural icons secretly giving their final interviews - which will be announced and aired posthumously.
items.brief: A documentary series featuring final interviews with cultural icons aired after their deaths.

items.title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
items.synopsis: Rita Moreno (born Rosa Dolores Alverío Marcano; December 11, 1931) is a Puerto Rican actress, dancer, and singer. With a career spanning eight decades, she is known for her roles on stage and screen, and is one of the last remaining stars from the Golden Age of Hollywood.…
items.brief: A documentary about musician Fito Páez.

items.title: Gandhari
items.synopsis: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.
items.brief: When a mother loses her eyesight and daughter to kidnapping, she hunts down those responsible.

items.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
items.synopsis: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.
items.brief: Orphaned children, journalists, Afghans and Marines share how the 9/11 attacks and War on Terror shaped them.

items.title: Mal de Amores
items.synopsis: Daniel Cuenca lives for revolution. Dr. Antonio Zavalza heals its wounds. Fiery Emilia must choose whom she loves more as Mexico transforms around her.
items.brief: Emilia must choose between Daniel, a revolutionary, and Dr. Zavalza as Mexico transforms around them.

items.title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
items.synopsis: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.
items.brief: Jared Freid jokes about vacationing with his parents and dating a literal Chad.

items.title: WWE NXT Heatwave 2026
items.synopsis: The 2024 NXT Heatwave was a professional wrestling event produced by the American company WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's developmental brand, NXT. It was the third annual Heatwave produced by WWE for NXT and the 10th Heatwave overall.…
items.brief: Professional wrestlers from WWE's developmental brand NXT compete in this event.

items.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas (Season 1)
items.synopsis: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.
items.brief: Two pianists from different worlds meet at an elite music school and their lives become intertwined.

items.title: Mezarlık (Season 3)
items.synopsis: Mezarlık is a dark basement, where a special unit works to solve unsolved murders of women. Commissioner Önem, will have to fight masculine prejudices that support male violence.
items.brief: A unit investigates unsolved murders of women while Commissioner Önem fights masculine prejudices enabling male violence.

items.title: Toda la verdad de mis mentiras
items.synopsis: Two roommates find their friendship tested by unspoken feelings during a road trip in this "light, refreshing and entertaining" rom-com hailed by Woman.
items.brief: Two roommates' friendship is tested by unspoken feelings during a road trip.

items.title: Mousetrap
items.synopsis: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."
items.brief: A reclusive writer's stolen identity forces him to ally with a loan shark to reclaim his life.

items.title: Chumbak
items.synopsis: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.
items.brief: Five quirky families navigate life with chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics in Chumbak Colony.

items.title: The Whisper Man
items.synopsis: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.
items.brief: After his son vanishes, a widower reunites with his retired detective father to catch a serial killer.

items.title: The Secret Woman
items.synopsis: A woman with memory loss discovers she has a family and a shipping empire. She returns to a seemingly perfect past to uncover the truth about why she left.
items.brief: A woman with memory loss discovers she has a family and shipping empire, then uncovers why she left.

items.title: Tyler Perry's Beauty in Black (Season 3)
items.synopsis: Beauty in Black follows two women leading very different lives. While Kimmie is struggling to make a living after her mother kicked her out and Mallory is running a successful business, they find themselves entangled in each other's lives.
items.brief: Struggling Kimmie and successful businesswoman Mallory find their very different lives becoming entangled.

items.title: Leanne (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Leanne's life takes an unexpected turn when her husband of 33 years leaves her for another woman. Starting over when you're a grandmother and in menopause isn't exactly what she had in mind, but with the help of her family she will navigate this new chapter with grace, dignity and jello salad.
items.brief: After her husband of 33 years leaves, a grandmother navigates starting over during menopause with family support.

items.title: Cien años de soledad (Season 2)
items.synopsis: The story of the Buendia family, who lived for a century in the town of Macondo. It will be the first time that Gabriel García Márquez's seminal novel One Hundred Years of Solitude is adapted for the screen, more than 50 years after it was originally published, in 1967.
items.brief: The Buendia family's century-long story in Macondo, the first screen adaptation of García Márquez's novel.

items.title: Nouvelle École (Season 5)
items.synopsis: French rappers freestyle, battle and write their way to a game-changing 100,000 euro prize in a music competition series judged by Niska, Shay and SCH.
items.brief: French rappers freestyle and battle for a 100,000 euro prize judged by Niska, Shay and SCH.

items.title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
items.synopsis: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.
items.brief: A documentary examining Mica Miller's life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

items.title: Sua Mãe Te Conhece
items.synopsis: In this new reality show format, nine mothers secretly bet on the choices their adult children will make, putting their familial bonds to the test.
items.brief: Nine mothers secretly bet on the choices their adult children make, testing family bonds.

items.title: The Last Salute
items.synopsis: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.
items.brief: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter through stories of generations of Indian Air Force pilots.

items.title: Untold (Season 7)
items.synopsis: Untold is a sports docuseries that brings fresh eyes to some of the greatest stories in sports. From tennis to boxing to basketball, these stories aren't the ones you've heard before, even if you think you have.
items.brief: A sports docuseries exploring lesser-known stories from tennis, boxing, basketball and beyond.

items.title: Stamptown
items.synopsis: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.
items.brief: Circus and comedy acts collide in this anarchic variety show with adult content.

items.title: Facing El Chapo
items.synopsis: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.
items.brief: Two Mexican officers must survive their final shift after crossing paths with a ruthless cartel boss.

items.title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
items.synopsis: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.
items.brief: A husband must adjust to living under his in-laws' roof when his bride refuses to leave her family home.

items.title: Outer Banks (Season 5)
items.synopsis: On an island of haves and have-nots, teen John B enlists his three best friends to hunt for a legendary treasure linked to his father's disappearance.
items.brief: Teen John B and friends hunt legendary treasure linked to his father's disappearance on an island.

items.title: Blodsoffer
items.synopsis: Detective Berg has given up on his absent ex-cop father - until a double police murder forces them back together.
items.brief: Detective Berg reunites with his absent ex-cop father when a double police murder forces them together.

items.title: S&X
items.synopsis: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.
items.brief: Sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse sexual issues with sincerity while hiding his own struggle.

items.title: Chompoo: Lost & Forgotten
items.synopsis: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?
items.brief: When a girl vanishes from a remote village, the police hunt becomes a media spectacle.

items.title: Love Is Blind: UK (Season 3)
items.synopsis: Emma and Matt Willis host a social experiment where British singles look for love and get engaged before meeting in person. But who will say "I do"?
items.brief: British singles get engaged without meeting, then discover if they'll marry in this social experiment.

items.title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
items.synopsis: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..
items.brief: After Boeing whistleblower John Barnett's death, an investigation uncovers revelations in the company's deepening crisis.

items.title: Here the Whole Time
items.synopsis: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.
items.brief: An insecure teenager's vacation is disrupted when his school crush moves in for two weeks, causing emotional chaos.

items.title: Ravu Jôtô (Season 2)
items.synopsis: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.
items.brief: Rebellious yankiis live together for 14 days clashing and bonding in search of love.

items.title: Take a Hike!
items.synopsis: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?
items.brief: Four celebrity hiking newbies form a club to tackle Korea's snow-capped peaks.

items.title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
items.synopsis: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.
items.brief: Kelsey Cook explores hangxiety and relives a plane bathroom nightmare in this stand-up special.

items.title: WWE Monday Night RAW (Season 33)
items.synopsis: WWE Monday Night RAW is World Wrestling Entertainment's (formerly the WWF and the WWWF before that) premiere wrestling event and brand. Since its launch in 1993, WWE Monday Night RAW continues to air live on Monday nights. It is generally seen as the company's flagship program due to its prolific history, high ratings, weekly live format, and emphasis on pay-per-views. Monday Night RAW is high profile enough to attract frequent visits from celebrities who usually serve as guest hosts for a single live event. Since its first episode, the show has been broadcast live or recorded from more than 197 different arenas in 165 cities and towns in seven different nations: including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom twice a year, Afghanistan for a special Tribute to the Troops, Germany, Japan, Italy and Mexico.
items.brief: WWE's flagship wrestling show featuring live matches and celebrity guests on Monday nights since 1993.

items.title: The Adam Ray Show
items.synopsis: Same host. Different characters. All chaos. Each week, Adam Ray taps into his roster of alter egos to interview famous guests — and no one is safe.
items.brief: Adam Ray uses his roster of alter egos to interview famous guests each week with chaotic results.

items.title: Umthetho
items.synopsis: A skilled young public prosecutor is pulled into a brutal prison syndicate led by the brother she thought she lost. Forcing her to choose between justice and family, law and survival, truth and betrayal.
items.brief: A prosecutor faces her lost brother leading a prison syndicate, forcing her to choose between justice and family.

items.title: Moria
items.synopsis: In this highly stylized fictionalization, Moria Casán transforms her life story into a symbolic spectacle of fame, controversy and ceaseless reinvention.
items.brief: Moria Casán transforms her life story into a spectacle of fame, controversy and reinvention.

items.title: Don’t Say Good Luck
items.synopsis: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical — until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.
items.brief: A high school musical lead faces more personal drama than stage drama.

items.title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
items.synopsis: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.
items.brief: Best friends Olli and Matze plan to travel the world until Matze's romance with Rebecca upends everything.

items.title: To the Max
items.synopsis: Three skydivers died in similar accidents within five years. Salvador Calvo wanted to tell their stories with the sole survivor, Carlos Suárez.
items.brief: Three skydivers died in similar accidents; the sole survivor Carlos Suárez tells their stories.

items.title: Tires (Season 3)
items.synopsis: At his father's auto shop, a hapless manager strives to improve customer service and drive profits while keeping his troublemaking cousin in line.
items.brief: A manager at his father's auto shop works to improve profits while managing his troublemaking cousin.

items.title: My Brilliant Career
items.synopsis: Sybylla is a shockingly modern young woman with one searing ambition - to be a writer, while her family is determined to marry her off. With an irrepressible taste for fun, Sybylla breaks every convention of 1900 Australia as she searches for a story that will allow her to write her way to independence. For her, the choice between adventure or marriage seems easy, until she falls in love. Will Sybylla marry, or will she risk it all for a creative life?
items.brief: Sybylla is determined to be a writer in 1900 Australia, breaking conventions as she chooses between adventure and love.

items.title: A Child of My Own
items.synopsis: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.
items.brief: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family expectations, a woman fakes pregnancy and gets tangled in crime.

items.title: MLB Field of Dreams: Phillies vs. Twins (LIVE)
items.synopsis: The Philadelphia Phillies face the Minnesota Twins in a regular-season game at the Field of Dreams ballpark in Dyersville, Iowa — baseball’s return to the cornfields, streamed live on Netflix.
items.brief: The Phillies face the Twins in a regular-season game at the Field of Dreams ballpark in Dyersville, Iowa.

items.title: This, That and Everything in Between
items.synopsis: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the complexities of their dysfunctional family.
items.brief: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets.

items.title: The Love Lab
items.synopsis: An innovative dating experiment reality show that breaks away from the conventions of traditional dating programs. Unfamiliar men and women are placed in extreme and controlled environments, facing unexpected experiments such as blind dates in bed and romances in isolation. Through unpredictable situations, the show dynamically captures the participants' raw, instinctive emotions and the realistic changes in their relationships.
items.brief: Men and women face unexpected experiments revealing raw emotions and realistic relationship changes.

items.title: Let's Marry Harry
items.synopsis: Harry Jowsey is done playing the field. Now, his inner circle is stepping in to help steer his love life, weighing in on every date, every match, and every tough call as he navigates a handpicked pool of potential partners. Is Harry finally ready to find a wife and settle down for good?
items.brief: Harry Jowsey's inner circle helps navigate his love life among handpicked potential partners.

items.title: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
items.synopsis: In never-before-heard prison calls recorded before his death, convicted killer Charles Manson reveals the twisted motivations for his gruesome crimes.
items.brief: In prison calls, convicted killer Charles Manson reveals his motivations for his crimes.

items.title: Nando Between Two Worlds
items.synopsis: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.
items.brief: Nando is caught between family and criminal obligations, facing an impossible choice about his loyalties.

items.title: Mourinho (Season 1)
items.synopsis: Iconic game footage, sideline antics, interviews with top footballers and tales from the man himself tell the story of José Mourinho's firecracker career.
items.brief: Iconic footage, sideline antics and interviews tell the story of José Mourinho's career.

items.title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
items.synopsis: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.
items.brief: Rory Scovel delivers laughs with a hypothetical home invasion, biblical reenactment and his father's wish.
